d:
Agar aap bina zyada risk lie lanbe samay ke lie paisa bachana chahte hain, to aapne PPF yani Public Provident Fund ke bare men zarur suna hoga. lekin saval ye hai ki PPF men kitna paisa dalen aur kitne sal tak, taki ek bara phand taiyar ho sake?
Har mahine itni inkam ho jae ki ek tarah se penshan se bharpaee ho jae.
Aaj ke paisa vasul men bat pipieph se jure savalon ki.
Prodyusar- dinesh upreti
Enkar- upasna
Edit- mahroz
BBC World Service ke nae aip ko daunlod karen.
BBC News hindi ko chunen aur paie nyuz alart, laiv tivi, podkast... sab ek jagah.
